rules.message: We want you to be completely safe. Please speak to someone who can help right now. Support is free, confidential, and available 24/7.
Fainting or severe dizziness combined with heavy bleeding needs immediate medical attention to check your blood pressure and blood count.
Soaking through one or more menstrual pads every hour for two consecutive hours is considered unusually rapid blood loss.
Any vaginal bleeding or sharp abdominal pain during pregnancy requires an immediate check with an obstetrician.
High fever, chills, or sudden heavy bleeding after childbirth can be a sign of infection and needs urgent clinical care.
A new breast lump or localized skin dimpling is best examined in person by a clinician within the week for routine clarity.
